family.instructions: Which use-case family best fits the problem in `problem`? Choose the closest; use `other` only when nothing fits.

criteria.inbound_triage: Route/triage inbound messages, tickets, PRs; respond vs wait vs escalate
criteria.selection: Pick which tool, skill, model, or agent should act
criteria.guardrails: Screen LLM inputs/outputs or check generated drafts for shape/policy
criteria.ui_automation: Drive a browser, desktop, or mobile UI from screen state
criteria.interactive_loop: Per-tick decisions in a game, trading, or robot/agent loop
criteria.reranking: Rerank or filter retrieval candidates before an LLM
criteria.extraction: Pull typed values/spans from messy text
criteria.batch_analysis: Judge a large stored corpus in bulk
criteria.high_cardinality: Classify into large or deep label sets
criteria.action_gating: Gate a real-world side effect (pay, publish, contain)
criteria.eval_observability: Grade or observe another AI's runs/traces

topology.instructions: Which call structure best fits the problem in `problem`? Point=one call/one decision; fanout=many parallel questions over shared state; chain=call_2 depends on call_1's answer; loop=same call per tick; map=same call over many items; beam=expand top-k deeper; tournament=items judged against each other; diamond=independent legs fan-in to a composite.

criteria.T1_fanout: Several independent questions over the same state in one call
criteria.T2_chain: A later call's questions/state depend on an earlier call's answer
criteria.T3_loop: Same call repeated with fresh state each tick/step
criteria.T4_map: Same call mapped over many independent records/candidates
criteria.T5_beam: Expand only top-k branches into deeper calls (deep label spaces)
criteria.T6_tournament: Items adjudicated against each other or a stored set
criteria.T7_diamond: Independent sub-judgments combined into one composite

needs_sequential.instructions: The problem genuinely needs sequential calls: a later judgment depends on an earlier judgment's answer (route-then-deepen, select-then-verify, screen-then-analyze).

needs_parallel_map.instructions: The problem involves running the same judgment over many independent items (a corpus, a candidate list, N submissions).

needs_loop.instructions: The problem involves a repeating decision over fresh state each step (per-tick control, streaming events, iterate-until-converged).

uses_noul.instructions: Yes/no probability questions are needed for this problem.

uses_choice.instructions: Pick-one-of-a-set questions are needed for this problem.

uses_score.instructions: Rubric/level scoring questions are needed for this problem.

risk_level.instructions: How risky is acting on this judgment? Pick the level whose situation matches (lowest=cosmetic, highest=money/legal/irreversible).

granularity.instructions: How wide is the problem? Pick the level whose situation matches (lowest=one narrow decision, highest=wide system needing decomposition).
criteria: one flow with a couple of questions
a feature: a few related flows
